This market will resolve in favor of the player that finishes Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the most receiving touchdowns.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 6 of the 2026-27 regular season count.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player with more receiving yards in Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the player with a higher yards per reception average in Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is shortened or truncated for any reason, the outcome shall be determined using available NFL statistics for completed games.

If Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past November 4, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or it is unclear which player led the NFL in receiving touchdowns within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
